acceptanceCriteria: A cem/1.0 sidecar that passes the stable verifier for the exact base/target grants the same reuse a cem/0.x sidecar does, with a positive test and edited-bytes, wrong-base and missing-artifacts refusal controls.
CEM-V1-150 is amended in place and TestExplicitSidecarReuseRequiresCanonicalMap prepares the default cem/1.0 map.
body: Source: V1-1276 builder report and docs/build-log/2026-10-12-v1-1276-dogfood-producer-cem-1-0.md 'Limits and NOT_RUN' (PR beamfall/corvint#837, merge 9deae4838). Decision 0525: RC3 ships cem/1.0 only; V1-1278 removes the 0.x readers, so each surface below must read cem/1.0 before or with that removal. internal/localcompletion sidecar-only reuse binds only canonical cem/0.x CEMs; a cem/1.0 sidecar grants no reuse and the check reruns (CEM-V1-150, fail closed). Expected: reuse admitted only through a stable verifier ACCEPT over the exact sidecar bytes with --artifacts <absolute root> and full 40-hex IDs; stale, edited or wrong-base sidecars refuse.
title: Local completion: grant sidecar-only reuse for a verified cem/1.0 change map (CEM-V1-150)
